title: CCC Result, Admit Card, Certificate, Online Form
organization: National Institute of Electronics & Information Technology
selectionProcess: Online registration / application as per portal process
documentsRequired: Aadhaar, photo ID, mobile number, email, supporting certificates as required
howToApply:
1. Visit https://student.nielit.gov.in
2. Apply for CCC exam when cycle is open
3. Download admit card before exam
4. Check result after declaration
5. Download digital certificate / verification
shortDescription: CCC Online Form, Admit Card, Result and Certificate – all services on NIELIT student portal.
content:
Complete CCC (Course on Computer Concepts) services under NIELIT:

  • Online examination form
  • Admit card download
  • Result checking
  • Digital certificate download and verification

Portal: student.nielit.gov.in / nielit.gov.in.
